tournaments.title: NEXUSX ARENA CLASH – DUO 2V2
tournaments.description:
NEXUSX ARENA CLASH – DUO 2V2

FIGHT TOGETHER. WIN TOGETHER.

Welcome to NEXUSX ARENA CLASH – DUO 2V2, where teamwork meets competition!

Get ready to enter the arena with your partner and experience an exciting BGMI competitive environment. This tournament is designed for players who enjoy teamwork, coordination, smart strategies, and intense head-to-head competition.

Build your duo, prepare your game plan, and bring your best performance to the battlefield.

THE DUO CHALLENGE

Every team has an opportunity to showcase its coordination, communication, and competitive spirit. Work together, support your teammate, and make every round count.

MATCH FORMAT – BEST OF 3

A maximum of 3 matches (rounds) will be played.

The team that wins 2 matches first will be declared the winner.

If a team wins the first two matches, the third match will not be required.

If the score reaches 1–1, the third match will decide the winner.

The winning team will be eligible for the announced prize, subject to the official tournament rules.

REGISTRATION & PRIZE DETAILS

Entry Fee: ₹50 per Duo Team

Total Prize Pool: ₹200

REGISTRATION

Register your two-player team through the official registration form. Make sure all submitted player details are accurate.

Stay connected with official NEXUSX ESPORTS INDIA announcements for tournament updates.

BRING YOUR PARTNER. ENTER THE ARENA. MAKE YOUR MARK.

NEXUSX ESPORTS INDIA

PLAY. COMPETE. DOMINATE.

registration.instructions: Register your two-player team using the official DUO registration form. Enter accurate Team Name, BGMI IGN, UID, and captain contact details. Both players must use their registered BGMI accounts.
registration.additionalInstructions: Both teammates must participate using their registered accounts and follow the selected weapon restriction. Keep the captain's WhatsApp number active for official updates. Join at the confirmed reporting time and follow all organizer instructions.
